content.comment_body: Hi, I tried sending an e-mail with the [product_name] communication module, but I received error code 56 each time I attempted. The e-mail parameters seem correct and the SIM card works (tested on a smartphone). I'm unable to find information about this error code online. Can someone assist?

Hello, You can refer to [url] for details about error 56: CURLE_RECV_ERROR (56) - Failure with receiving network data. This may indicate that your data connection isn't functioning as expected. Are you able to configure a NTP server to receive time through the mobile interface? Also, which SMTP server are you using? Best regards

Hi, After activating time synchronization, the e-mail still won't send. The SMTP server being used is smtp.gmail.com. The SIM card works fine in a smartphone, so the provider shouldn't be the issue. Thank you for your support.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters persistent error code 56 when attempting to send e-mails through a [product_name] communication module. Discussion points to issues with troubleshooting due to limited documentation and unclear error messages. There are also potential problems with network connectivity when connecting to standard SMTP servers. Users find system feedback unhelpful, which adds to frustration when trying to resolve such errors.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for dependable e-mail functionality with mainstream SMTP servers and desires clearer error messages and troubleshooting instructions, seeking more transparency and easily accessible solutions when problems arise.
